_doc: Cada habilidad requiere: id (unico), name, description, effect (clave interna del motor). Opcional: hook (punto de activacion: onDamageCalc, onEntry, onWeather, onAccuracy, onContact, onTurnEnd, onStatusCheck, onCritCheck, onSecondaryEffect, onPreventFlinch, onOverride, onUtility), type (para afinidad elemental), multiplier, chance, status, hpThreshold, fraction.
